abstract_summary: Personalized language agents use persistent memory to adapt to users over time, but the same mechanism creates an attack surface. When new information conflicts with stored preferences, an agent must distinguish genuine preference drift from temporary context shifts, ambiguity, or adversarial memory poisoning. We fo...
citation: CAPTURE: Disentangling Preference Drift from Memory Poisoning in Personalized LLM Agents. S M Asif Hossain, Ruksat Khan Shayoni, Md Kishor Morol. 2026-09-02. https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02265

scholarly_quality.concise_summary: This paper presents an exceptional, rigorous contribution combining theoretical analysis, well-engineered architectural design, and unusually rigorous empirical validation. The inclusion of strong supervision-matched controls, independent human red-teaming, adaptive attacks, and frank reporting of negative/modest transfer results satisfies rigorous curation standards.

Hypotheses live as nodes in a directed graph over a vector store (Johnson et al., 2021), with edges recording support
and contradiction. Each node sits in one of three layers, and each layer carries a base decay rateγ, so that the
confidence of a node at timetwhose last corroboration was att 0 isc 0 σ(ht) exp(−γ(t−t 0)), wherec 0 ∈(0,1]is the
confidence at write time andσ(h t)∈(0,1)is a scalar sigmoid read-off from the gate's latent belief, trained jointly
withf θ and shared across node types.
We distinguish the learned components from the fixed ones. The dynamicsf θ and the modulationσare learned
end to end; the three base rates are not. They are selected once by grid search on validation and frozen for every
experiment, atγ s = 0.01,γ c = 0.1, andγ g = 0.5, in units of days. The layer sets a prior on how fast a class of belief
fades and the learned component determines the departure

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims are carefully bounded and transparently aligned with empirical evidence. The authors explicitly document where architectural gains diminish versus strong supervision-matched baselines, note that adaptive attackers eliminate their security lead over simple provenance filtering, and transparently declare falsification criteria.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Empirical evaluation is comprehensive and methodologically sound, testing across synthetic benchmarks (D-PREFGUARD), an independent external benchmark (HorizonBench), and an offline-replayed 40-participant longitudinal user study. Crucially, the authors include extensive controls, paired statistical tests with Holm adjustments, ablation experiments, and realistic adversarial testing including an adaptive white-box surrogate attacker and independent human red-teamers.
primary.limitations: Limitations are clearly addressed, including the text-only threat model, remaining vulnerabilities to same-origin and slow gradual attacks, the shrinkage of performance gains when tested on independent external distributions, and increased per-turn inference latency.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed with mathematical proofs for theoretical bounds, well-specified continuous-discrete neural ODE dynamics, structured hypothesis extraction, multi-layer decay configurations, and decoupled safety-constrained response generation.
primary.quality_rationale: This paper presents an exceptional, rigorous contribution combining theoretical analysis, well-engineered architectural design, and unusually rigorous empirical validation. The inclusion of strong supervision-matched controls, independent human red-teaming, adaptive attacks, and frank reporting of negative/modest transfer results satisfies rigorous curation standards.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper formalizes the preference-authenticity ambiguity in personalized LLM memory as a continuous-time partially observable decision process and bounds the error of heuristics relying solely on recency and provenance. It proposes CAPTURE, an architecture integrating a continuous-time neural ODE authenticity gate, a multi-timescale layered ledger with quarantine mechanics, epistemic probing, and counterfactual causal auditing.

scholarly_quality.rationale: This paper presents an exceptional, rigorous contribution combining theoretical analysis, well-engineered architectural design, and unusually rigorous empirical validation. The inclusion of strong supervision-matched controls, independent human red-teaming, adaptive attacks, and frank reporting of negative/modest transfer results satisfies rigorous curation standards.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: Limitations are clearly addressed, including the text-only threat model, remaining vulnerabilities to same-origin and slow gradual attacks, the shrinkage of performance gains when tested on independent external distributions, and increased per-turn inference latency.
